llm.reply:
The genes associated with cystic fibrosis in the retrieved records are NCBIGene:1080, NCBIGene:2212 and NCBIGene:7040. NCBIGene:1080 is named CF transmembrane conductance regulator [1]. NCBIGene:2212 is named Fc gamma receptor IIa [3]. NCBIGene:7040 is named transforming growth factor beta 1 [4].

## Disease Concept

The associated disease record is named Cystic fibrosis [2]. Its MedGen concept carries the title Cystic fibrosis [6]. The literature index normalizes it to the entity Cystic Fibrosis [7].

## Clinical Features

MedGen lists Bronchiectasis as a clinical feature [15]. Hemoptysis is also listed [28]. Clubbing of fingers is another listed feature [19]. Hepatosplenomegaly is recorded as well [30].

## Literature Context

One report notes that liver disease is common in cystic fibrosis [26: "Cystic fibrosis liver disease (CFLD) affects a large proportion of cystic fibrosis (CF) patients"]. Encephalopathy, by contrast, is uncommon [26: "encephalopathy is a rare complication"]. Steroids can trigger a hyperammonemic form of it [26: "\"hyperammonemic encephalopathy\" can be precipitated in previously stable CFLD by various triggers including systemic corticosteroids"].

## Clinical Trials

One registered trial is Assessment of Quadriceps Muscle Electrostimulation Used in Patients Suffering From Cystic Fibrosis [8]. Another is Pregnancies and Cystic Fibrosis [24].

The knowledge graph links three genes to cystic fibrosis. NCBIGene:1080 is CF transmembrane conductance regulator [1]. NCBIGene:2212 is Fc gamma receptor IIa [3]. NCBIGene:7040 is transforming growth factor beta 1 [4]. The disease record is named Cystic fibrosis [2].

## Disease Record Context

The MedGen concept is titled Cystic fibrosis [6]. The literature index normalizes the entity as Cystic Fibrosis [7]. Clinical features listed for this concept include Asthma [11]. They include Bronchiectasis [15]. They include Clubbing of fingers [19]. They include Dehydration [23]. They include Diarrhea [27]. They include Hemoptysis [28]. They include Hepatomegaly [29]. They include Hepatosplenomegaly [30].

## Literature

One retrieved paper is Encephalopathy in cystic fibrosis. [5]. It reports that encephalopathy is uncommon in CF liver disease [26: "encephalopathy is a rare complication"], and that it can be triggered by systemic steroids [26: "can be precipitated in previously stable CFLD by various triggers including systemic corticosteroids"]. Other titles include 3.22 Nutrition in Cystic Fibrosis. [10]. Another is Editorial: Cystic Fibrosis in Children. [14]. Another is Azithromycin and cystic fibrosis. [18]. Another is Editorial: Cystic fibrosis-related diabetes. [22]. Linked publications include PMID 32800451 [9]. They include PMID 35240644 [13]. They include PMID 35592838 [17]. They include PMID 35853636 [21]. They include PMID 39129918 [25].

## Clinical Trials

Relevant trials include Assessment of Quadriceps Muscle Electrostimulation Used in Patients Suffering From Cystic Fibrosis [8]. Another is Pregnancies and Cystic Fibrosis [24]. Some retrieved trials concern fibrocystic breast disease rather than cystic fibrosis, such as A Study of Topical Danazol for the Treatment of Pain Associated With Fibrocystic Breast Disease [12]. Another is Efficacy and Safety of ONCOXIN in Patients With Breast Fibrocystic Disease [16]. Another is A Clinical Study on the Efficacy and Safety of the Treatment of Hyperplasia of Mammary Glands With Xiaoru Sanjie Capsule [20].
